scientific_question: Can the confirmed P_T/L_T mechanism be compressed into a closed executable item-potential state plus edge-addressed local memory without fitting Liu behavior?
current_theory: P_T performs state-dependent iterative global reassembly and L_T preserves broader direct evidence on query-addressed conjunctive keys. Terminal global logits are nearly additive, but that output geometry does not establish that the item potential is a sufficient dynamical state.
primary_hypothesis: A shared rank-2 state-by-evidence transition on the centered eight-item potential, together with an exactly reassembled edge-memory kernel, preserves prefix dynamics, remote relation-LOO reassembly, the P/L double dissociation, and the frozen behavioral reproduction categories across held-out development backbones and untouched Liu preservation backbones.
claim_boundary: A pass supports one low-capacity executable algorithm for these frozen eight-item backbones and task distribution. It does not identify a unique algorithm, a human or biological mechanism, item-count generalization, population prevalence, or exact P_T state equivalence. Failure rejects the registered rank-2 potential-only closure, not all potential-state transitions or low-dimensional augmented states.
forbidden_targets: human accuracy, symbolic-distance slope, serial-position profile, error class, Hodge ranking, or ranking diversity during fitting
any Liu participant, support schedule, pair label, behavior, or comparator during fitting
checkpoint, gain, temperature, threshold, rank, optimizer, episode, seed, or relation selection after results are observed
changing P_T, L_T, tanh, W_out, temperature, evidence access, or the frozen v2.4 equation

development_artifacts.role: generic-only transition extraction, fitting, and leave-one-backbone-out evaluation

preservation_artifacts.role: untouched Liu-only external preservation after all reduced parameters are frozen

generic_trajectory_contract.task_distribution: unchanged GenericRankingTaskGenerator with eight items, cue size 15, 7 through 10 connected edges, four support blocks, stable omission, and both Liu graph signatures excluded
generic_trajectory_contract.prefixes: P_0 after two blank steps and every P_t after one complete passive support trial
generic_trajectory_contract.full_field_readout: At each prefix query all 28 unordered item pairs in both orientations at the frozen generic support-query time, resetting hidden state and eligibility per query and freezing P_t. Define m_ij=0.5[(z1-z0)_ij-(z1-z0)_ji], then take the raw centered complete-graph Hodge potential s_t.
generic_trajectory_contract.evidence: x_t equals signed effective displayed magnitude times (e_left-e_right), using the same stable relation admission that enters the frozen global backbone; omitted presentations have x_t=0.
generic_trajectory_contract.relation_loo: For each episode select the lexicographically first globally retained graph relation and replay all four presentations with only its effective magnitude set to zero. Preserve every cue, orientation, time, and other support value. Retain the natural and LOO terminal full fields and potentials.
generic_trajectory_contract.no_raw_checkpoint_state_target: P_t tensors may be retained only for exact replay identity checks; they are not inputs to either registered reduced model.

local_compression_contract.edge_state: a_(t+1)=a_t+s_t^L e_(r_t), with one coordinate per oriented canonical unordered edge and sign absorbed into s_t^L
local_compression_contract.kernel: K_qr=k_q^T k_r from the unchanged normalized antisymmetric conjunctive addresses
local_compression_contract.exactness_gate: Across every generic extraction episode and both Liu preservation backbones, K a_T must equal the original tensor-state dot-query read to maximum absolute error at most 1e-6.
local_compression_contract.identity_kernel_null: Also report K=I with the same a_T and lambda_L. It is a further-compression diagnostic only and cannot rescue or veto the primary exact-K algorithm.

global_models.gauge: Pi=I-11^T/8 is applied after every update; all s and x are centered eight-vectors.
global_models.state_dependent_candidate: s_(t+1)=Pi[s_t+A x_t+U((V^T s_t) elementwise-multiplied by (W^T x_t))]
global_models.teacher_initialization_diagnostic: Repeat rollout from the full neural s_0; this may localize initialization error but cannot make the primary algorithm pass.
global_models.unconstrained_bilinear_diagnostic: A frozen ridge regression on [x_t, vec(s_t outer-product x_t)] is reported only to distinguish rank-2 capacity failure from broader evidence against this feature family; it cannot make the primary algorithm pass.

fit_contract.folds: Three leave-one-backbone-out folds. Fit one shared model to both nonheld development backbones and evaluate only on all 128 episodes of the held backbone. Episodes differ across backbones, so each fold jointly tests new episodes and a new implementation.
fit_contract.final_preservation_fit: After all folds, fit once on all 384 generic development episodes with the same frozen procedure and apply that fixed parameter set to both Liu preservation backbones.
fit_contract.loss: unweighted float64 mean squared one-step potential error over every support transition, including omitted x_t=0 steps
fit_contract.accumulator_fit: closed-form ridge least squares with lambda=1e-6
fit_contract.candidate_fit: Initialize A from the accumulator solution; initialize U,V,W from N(0,0.01) with seed 45101 plus held-out seed for folds and 45199 for the final fit; full-batch Adam, 2500 steps, learning rate 0.01, no weight decay, no scheduler, no early stopping, no restart, and no result-based selection
fit_contract.unconstrained_fit: closed-form ridge least squares with lambda=1e-6
fit_contract.device: GPU is mandatory for frozen neural extraction and candidate fitting; PyTorch CPU intraop and interop threads are each fixed to one.

mechanistic_estimands.one_step: Held-out transition MSE and NRMSE=MSE/sum_t||s_(t+1)-s_t||^2 per scalar component, plus paired per-episode candidate-minus-null squared error.
mechanistic_estimands.prefix_rollout: From s_0=0, report per-prefix cosine, centered RMSE, full-field RMSE, and induced pair-order agreement through terminal support; also report teacher-initialized diagnostics.
mechanistic_estimands.global_geometry: Report full neural Hodge fraction and reduced terminal field agreement; reduced additive Hodge fraction is an algebraic identity and not evidence by itself.
mechanistic_estimands.remote_reassembly: Compare natural-minus-LOO reduced and full terminal pair fields on direct, endpoint-sharing, and disjoint pairs; report vector correlation, remote magnitude ratio, and candidate-versus-null error.
mechanistic_estimands.history_dependence: The state-dependent candidate must improve held-out one-step and rollout errors over U=0; report fitted interaction norm and repeated-relation effects without interpreting a nonzero parameter alone as mechanism.
mechanistic_estimands.double_dissociation: On each untouched Liu backbone compare reduced P-on/L-on, P-on/L-off, and P-off/L-on. Global-only must retain nonlearned inference and remote LOO effects; local-only must retain direct learned benefit while nonlearned inference and remote effects collapse; L-off removes the local term exactly.
mechanistic_estimands.behavior_map: Re-run the frozen 9-row sampling and classification definitions on reduced P-on/L-on outputs. Preserve the per-network status category of every row; the three existing mismatches are not optimization targets.

bootstrap.unit: episode within held-out backbone for generic metrics and participant within preservation backbone for Liu metrics; networks are never pooled

primary_pass_rules.integrity: Every source, checkpoint, config, gain, schedule, shape, finite-value, gauge, readout antisymmetry, local exactness, and replay identity gate passes.
primary_pass_rules.one_step_state_dependence: In every held-out development backbone candidate NRMSE is at most 0.50, candidate MSE is at most 0.80 times accumulator MSE, and the 95 percent paired episode interval for candidate-minus-accumulator error lies below zero.
primary_pass_rules.prefix_trajectory: In every held-out development backbone the median all-prefix cosine is at least 0.95, terminal cosine is at least 0.95, terminal pair-order agreement is at least 0.90, and terminal centered RMSE is at most 0.50 times the RMS norm of the full terminal potential, all from s_0=0.
primary_pass_rules.remote_reassembly: In every held-out development backbone the candidate/full natural-minus-LOO pair-field correlation is at least 0.70, the mean absolute disjoint-effect ratio lies in [0.50,1.50], and candidate remote-field MSE is lower than accumulator remote-field MSE.
primary_pass_rules.double_dissociation: Separately in seeds 2104 and 2105, reduced global-only nonlearned exact accuracy exceeds 0.70 and is within 0.05 of reduced intact; reduced local-only learned exact accuracy exceeds 0.55 while nonlearned exact accuracy is at most 0.55; local-only remote relation-LOO magnitude is at most 25 percent of intact and global-only remote magnitude is positive.
primary_pass_rules.behavior_preservation: Separately in seeds 2104 and 2105, all nine reduced behavior-map row categories exactly match that seed's frozen v2.4 reproduction-map categories. A newly calibrated human mismatch is not a benefit and counts as category nonpreservation.

outcome_tree.potential_only_state_dependent_algorithm: All integrity and primary pass rules hold in every mandatory development and preservation backbone. Promote (s_t,a_t) as the current reduced algorithm within the frozen scope.
outcome_tree.rank_2_potential_transition_insufficient: All integrity gates hold but any primary rule fails. Preserve every passed link and reject only the registered rank-2 potential-only closure. If the unconstrained bilinear diagnostic materially outperforms rank 2, next freeze a capacity-focused potential transition; otherwise next freeze one prospectively defined low-dimensional confidence/history augmentation. Do not edit v1 after seeing results.
outcome_tree.noninterpretable: Any source, artifact, replay, finite-value, gauge, local exactness, or required execution gate fails. Repair implementation or data provenance under a separately recorded lock before interpretation.

stop_rules: Do not change rank, thresholds, optimizer, seeds, episodes, initial state, evidence definition, or relation selection after execution.
Do not use 2104 or 2105 to fit, select, restart, or tune the reduced transition.
Do not claim s_t is insufficient as a Markov state from rank-2 failure alone.
Do not begin item-count or cross-task generalization unless the registered potential-only algorithm passes or a separately frozen revised reduced state passes.
